metadata.title: Active Directory environment traffic
metadata.artifact_scope_note: This pilot contains network telemetry only; no communications/chat or validated IDS/Suricata alert artifacts were available in the supplied dataset.

investigation_notes: Security network-traffic investigation scenario 'Active Directory environment traffic' from malware-traffic-analysis.net. The supplied evidence consists of parsed DNS, HTTP, TLS, connection-activity, User-Agent, and HTTP Server-header observations from the associated packet capture. This description intentionally does not state a root cause, impact, or confirmed C2 attribution; those must be established from the supplied artifacts.
